recap.text: Katia's team has more cards than they know what to do with, so she plops a deck of them onto the counter, and Carl sifts out Greased Lightning, which raises a mob's speed by 25%. Donut then flings it onto Shi Maria, who splits into four, one of them suddenly fast. She uses it again to finish a mud ball, and again on Raul the crab, who cuts a ghost's leg off.

beats.headline: From Katia's spare pile
beats.text: Katia's team has more cards than they know what to do with, dropped by little trolls called the Lads, and she plops a deck of them onto the counter. Carl sifts through it, grabs another Stout card and two utility cards he has not seen before: Blue Stuff, which increases a totem's supply of mana points, and Greased Lightning, which increases a mob's speed by 25%. Added to Geraldo, Carl thinks, it would make him ridiculously fast.
beats.gist: Carl takes Greased Lightning from Katia's spare pile; it speeds a mob by 25%.

beats.headline: Four spiders, one fast
beats.text: In the practice room's 1980s shopping mall, with Skylar Spinach split in two and fighting a reindeer herd, Donut's hand holds three cards and no totems. Play Greased Lightning on Shi Maria, Carl says. Donut flips it out toward the injured spider; it somersaults through the air like a boomerang and slaps onto her back. A giant lightning graphic appears with a crack, at the same moment Shi Maria casts an illusion and splits into four. One of the four is suddenly moving much more quickly than before.
beats.gist: Donut flips Greased Lightning onto Shi Maria, who splits into four; one copy speeds up.

beats.headline: Against the mud balls
beats.text: Carl and Donut lose the second of three deck-on-deck fights to a muddy blob guy whose deck is all tanks and snare cards. The blob hits Shi Maria with a Damnation card, and she wastes her time fighting a rolling mud ball with a high dodge. She only kills it after Donut hits her with Greased Lightning, and the blob simply summons another of the same monsters.
beats.gist: Donut's Greased Lightning kills a rolling mud ball, but the blob summons another.

beats.headline: To build his self-confidence
beats.text: Raul the crab is chasing a screeching ghost, a Reef Explorer, through the dark trees, and Lazarus wants to end it himself: that pansy is taking too long. Donut discards a card and tosses a Greased Lightning at Raul. It spins off like a ninja star, dodges a tree and hits the crab in a sparkle of digital confetti. Lazarus is to stay and protect her; Raul needs the experience. Raul snaps at the ghost, and when it tries to run behind a tree the speed-enhanced crab snaps again and cuts its leg off. It drops dead.
beats.gist: Donut tosses a Greased Lightning at Raul, and the sped-up crab snaps off the fleeing ghost's leg.

beats.headline: Onto Skylar Spinach
beats.text: Donut's active deck for the turkey barn holds two Greased Lightning cards. Her first totem is Skylar Spinach, who floats up toward the middle of the battlefield, and at the same moment she casts The Thief at the ogre, pulling a card out of the ogre's hand into her own deck. Weren't expecting that, were ya, she calls with autotuned glee, as she tosses a Greased Lightning onto Skylar.
beats.gist: Donut casts The Thief at the ogre and tosses a Greased Lightning onto her first totem, Skylar Spinach.
